{{Quote|The Force is a weapon. I will show you how to wield it.|Rance speaks to an acolyte|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Rance''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and an [[Overseer (Sith)|Overseer]] of the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Rance was of average height for a Human and had [[Color/Legends|light]] skin. He was remembered for his harsh method for [[Sith training|training]] the Sith [[Force Adept|adepts]], sending them to the Korriban wilds, where the students either died or driven mad, and forced to battle to death when they returned to their master.<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia">[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]</ref>
